observations: White all-in-one copier with a glass scanner bed and a control panel.
The brand 'SHARP' and model 'AR-M201' are visible on the control panel in photos 1 and 3.
The machine has a paper tray at the bottom and a document feeder on the right.
The scanner lid is open in photos 0, 1, and 3.
The control panel has a numeric keypad and function buttons for copy, scan, fax, and menu navigation.
The exterior casing shows significant surface wear, including scratches and scuffs, particularly on the top lid and sides.
